source.name: National Archives and Records Administration, National Archives Catalog

method: NARA Catalog proxy searches were run against the user-supplied 2010-0083-F release and broader Presidential Daily Diary term searches. PDF OCR text was reviewed with pdftotext -layout, and only high-confidence calls, meetings, summit sessions, and briefing entries relevant to FRUS Volume XVII were promoted as context records.

gaps.label: Diary is chronology, not substance
gaps.detail: Most entries identify the time, participants, and sometimes a general purpose; the compiler still needs memcons, telcons, briefing books, and source-image verification before selection.

gaps.label: Madrid summit release gap
gaps.detail: The July 1997 Madrid date-range PDF records a useful July 3 Kohl call, but the released July 8-10 diary pages are thin and do not capture formal NATO summit sessions.

gaps.label: Helsinki summit release gap
gaps.detail: The March 1997 Helsinki date-range PDF surfaced only late-day diary fragments, not the substantive Clinton-Yeltsin summit schedule; use trip files and memcons instead.

gaps.label: Partial releases and OCR noise
gaps.detail: The PDD packets include withdrawal/redaction sheets, partial pages, occasional OCR errors, and some malformed dates; check the page images/PDF before final citation.

gaps.label: Term search limitations
gaps.detail: NARA full-text hits vary by release and OCR vocabulary, so the report records the terms used and preserves NAIDs for re-querying additional names or summit labels.
